reviews.text: 买来玩了两把，第一个角色上来打两张牌技能一烧牌游戏结束了，第二个角色不停扔炸弹然后游戏也结束了，我不知道后面难度会不会慢慢上来或者这游戏其实是主打联机，但我说实话就目前体验的感觉来说有点没动力玩下去。 这游戏是类似斗地主的规则，牌打完就算赢，然后有技能和道具之类的。缝了异步排位的玩法， 但坏也坏在异步排位上面，因为一般的异步排位游戏都是自动战斗的，而这游戏是手动战斗，这就导致单机AI有点太弱了，没有什么交互感。跟小丑牌你变强后打的分数更高不同，由于这游戏的目的是要把牌打完，所以你变强前一堆操作把牌打完，变强后其实还是一堆操作把牌打完，没有什么获得了提升的爽感。

Did you ever play "President" or "Scum" growing up? Maybe you called it something else, but this is that game, not poker. Which I think is a great thing (even if the game's title makes no sense because of it), it makes it very different than existing playing card roguelikes like Balatro. If you're not familiar I'll explain how it works below as the game doesn't do a great job at that: Specifically in this game you play in online multiplayer (one on one or 3 people) battles and progress as a roguelike, as you will gain or buy new abilities between matches but each match is against another actual person or people (supposedly at least, they could be bots as this just released). Your ultimate goal each round to be the first to get rid of every card in your hand. One side places a hand down and the opponent has to respond. But you can only play cards of the same hand type (e.g a pair) of a higher value (e.g a pair of 4s over a pair of 2s) on top of the existing hand on the table so it's all about making strategic decisions on what to play, save, or counter with. If your opponent passes then the table is cleared and you can start with any hand you want. You may want to get rid of a low single or pair but you then leave the table opened for your opponent to easily counter or you may want to start with your more complex and higher card hand but then you won't have it later to counter your opponent, The roguelike elements are either passive or triggered abilities that either let you manipulate your hand, your opponent's hand, the played cards on the table, or trigger your character skill (which are a set main skill for each deck you choose). This is also done well as you basically build out what bs strategy you want over your run (though there is a bit of a lack of variety of special moves per deck to add). For instance, a "bomb" is the most powerful hand you can play, a hand of 4 cards that can go over any hand on the table or top of a bomb of a lower value. It is the highest hand you can play (even if it isn't the most cards you can play at once) and essential for winning. So maybe you make a deck that has abilities to basically increase your bomb opportunities by essentially converting cards to wild cards to increase more opportunities to make bombs and other modifiers that allow you to make bombs with less (more opportunities) or more cards (higher amount of discards per play). Maybe you create a build around voiding your cards so they no longer need to be played or discarded to win. Maybe you make a freezing deck that is all about blocking your opponent from playing their cards (which also makes me think the majority of players right now are still bots as even in group matches they literally only targeted me with this and never another opponent). Overall I got sucked in almost immediately and played for 2-3 hours straight. I really only have a few nitpicks with it. 1) Weird performance issues, I don't know why I can't get above 100 fps in a relatively low poly game with a 5070ti. It's not an issue per se because this is a turn based game, but weird how poorly it runs and may struggle on lower end devices. 2) Translation issues. I don't know how another non chinese English speaker who didn't grow up with the game figures this out without just playing for awhile. It's not explained very well and it's hard to understand often regardless with all the broken english. 3) It suffers from what a lot of these kinds of roguelikes suffer from, that winning is kind of anticlimactic and there in no end game. You just keep going to get a higher run score and unlock more things. It's all extrinsic value. 4) Needs more options in the store. I came across a more repeats of items and abilities than other roguelikes. But still, I very much recommend this, it's really unique and fun!

[h1]喜欢打牌的有福了，爽度爆表的恶魔牌！[/h1] [h2] 游戏背景 [/h2] 《恶魔牌》是一款以“斗地主”和“掼蛋”为灵感的卡牌策略Roguelike肉鸽游戏。 [h2]游戏玩法介绍[/h2] 法术牌机制，例如你目前的人物是龙母，龙母能孵化出火龙并使用火龙烧掉右侧所有的手牌，使用完后火龙会变成火龙蛋回到手牌之中，并且法术牌不会占用出牌机会。 每张角色卡都有专属技能，例如女皇的技能是龙母，角斗士的技能是给牌加愤怒，可给自身带来强大的收益，同时也增加了丰富的游戏性（这游戏真有点杀时间，上头了） 在每次击败一个野怪后，可以任意选择一张卡牌奖励添加到技能槽之中，需要注意的是主技能不能被替换。而在每次获得胜利后，可以使用金币购买喜欢的筹码与技能增强牌组，同样的技能可以叠加升级。 并且筹码与技能搭配起来效果非常猛，配合上一些角色的专属技能简直变态（专属技能的强度非常高，基本可以无脑赢）。 个人比较喜欢玩龙母，玩起来真的爽爆了，基本上是一路平推过去，烈焰术士感觉也挺爽的，烧牌烧起来也是一路平推。 并且游戏还支持联机对战，都支持联机那还说啥了，必须叫上朋友来殴打两把，整治一下！ [h2]游戏总结[/h2] 总的来说，游戏丰富的构筑与流派增加了使游戏性大大提高，玩起来也非常的爽，有时候玩着玩着就上头了，非常的杀时间（玩起来还不用动脑，这点我非常喜欢，毕竟平时学习都累个半死，打游戏不就为了放松爽一爽吗）。 并且还支持联机模式，可以叫上朋友们一起互相打打牌，定价也非常的友好，喜欢打牌的一定要试试好吧，推荐游玩！ [quote] 晚八不睡，早八不醒，梦里准点测评，迎接美好游戏人生！ 欢迎关注：[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/46039267/] 睡不醒的早八人 [/url] [/quote]

Decent deck builder roguelike with a fun gameplay loop and interesting concept. English translation needs serious work though as the wording is sometimes confusing, incomplete or just missing altogether in some cases. It's a fair spend at a discounted rate but Apokerlypse lacks a certain polish that should've been present on launch and was showcased as such in the marketing. As it is, the game is good but it could be a breakout hit if it gets post-launch updates containing: bug fixes, better optimization, item/skill balancing, and more content. The game would also greatly benefit from any amount of story elements, or characters, or any extra charm AT ALL to give the game more of an identity. Like, I don't NEED story and characters for my Balatro-likes but this game is doing itself a great disservice by not going the extra mile to add more value to what it's offering. Also, the music while nice at first, becomes quite repetitive very quickly due to it being a very short looping track with no variation. I would like to but can't really recommend until I can at least read everything in the game (including achievements) in English and if we're being honest... until the game is more polished. This kind of game should not have any stuttering or frame loss or especially crashes. *I have checked back since the update and the same translation issues still exist.*

This game is absurdly nostalgic for me. I ran track in high school some 20 years ago. At a state track meet some guys from another school taught me a game that plays exactly like this. You deal out the deck, someone plays a poker hand, everyone else has to match it but higher or pass, if play passes pack to you, you get to pick the new hand played. They called it 'killer'. I've been teaching this game to friends for 20 years when we had a deck and some down time. I had honestly thought it was just some regional game to play when bored. It was shocked to see a variant of it from Asia. 10/10, thanks for the memories.

I highly recommend the game. Pros: Lots of characters who each bring their own style of play to the table. Each character makes the game feel like you are playing a slightly different version and is a very nice change to most games where another character just means a passive skill. Lots of varieties of chips available, they each let you win in different ways, changing the rules of the game in fun and challenging ways. Nice quick games, roughly 30mins each which is nice for a pick up game whenever. Clean and aesthetically pleasing art style. Cons: Can be frustrating when you don't know why you lose, or some games when you are unable to do anything but pass. Lack of meta progression and/or things to unlock to keep you coming back for more Lack of items in the store, adding a few items in the store or more options to customise your deck etc. would make a huge difference. Overall I think this game brings something different and is fun and makes you feel smart when you line up the perfect hands, I would highly recommend this game to anyone reading this as I have to all my gamer friends

I feel extremely disappointed after purchasing and playing Apokerlypse. This game has countless obvious flaws. First of all, the game optimization is terrible. There are frequent lags, frame drops and operation response delays both in single-player and online matches. Clicking cards often fails to respond, and game freezing and disconnection happen all the time, which completely ruins the smooth gaming experience. Besides, there are plenty of in-game bugs, including abnormal achievement unlocking, lost game progress and messy UI display. The font is too small and skill descriptions are vague with poor translation quality, making it hard for foreign players to understand core rules. Secondly, the game balance is totally broken. Certain classes and builds are overwhelmingly powerful and dominate all matches, while most other characters and card combinations are too weak to compete. The game relies too much on random card draws instead of strategic gameplay. Players can hardly reverse the situation by their own operation, bringing strong frustration. In terms of game content, the gameplay is very single and repetitive. The play mode is limited, lacking rich levels, storylines and innovative mechanisms. It gets boring quickly after short-time play with low replay value. The online system is also incomplete, supporting only a small number of players with unstable connection, and it is unable to meet the needs of multi-player entertainment. What is more, the official update speed is slow. Most existing bugs have not been fixed timely after launch, and new game content is rarely added. Many players also meet unreasonable refund problems, and the after-sales service attitude is unsatisfying. In short, this product is rough and unfinished. It has serious problems in optimization, balance, content and server experience.

小丑牌我买过又退款了，因为起手只有8张牌，能换5张牌，总共13张牌，这有个屁的策略，纯纯看脸。 是的，上面说的是小丑牌不是恶魔牌，相反，恶魔牌以更多的手牌给出了更多的玩法，将我们习惯的"跑得快"(湖南)、"掼蛋"(江苏)等多种玩法作为基础，融合了各种能力以及状态(虚无、冻结、石化、百变)，对于新手玩家和休闲玩家来说，有了更多的玩法，由于初始卡牌、筹码、徽章又存在随机性，每一把都需要考虑组合的适应性，从而具备耐玩性。(对于高手们而言，大佬们想怎么玩就怎么玩) (注: 这个游戏对电脑游戏的配置还没啥要求，简直是我等福音) 综上所述，恶魔牌至少值得一个好评，且比起小丑牌更适合国人玩家。 一人一副牌，不知道你们为啥这么设计，无论是斗地主、掼蛋、跑得快，甚至三国杀，都是共用一套牌，其中设置了初始手牌和公共卡牌持，从而实现了资源抢占的玩法，不至于炸弹满天飞。。。。。其他牌型完全没有游玩体验，这一切都是一人一副牌导致的恶果，所以，你们为什么不和主流接轨????????? 如果共用一套牌，如果设置了抽卡的回合(反正你们都已经有回合的概念了)，公共卡牌池都能多出抢占的玩法，先抢公共卡更容易出炸弹，不抢公共卡需要出完牌的负担更小。 你们还有技能、能力的设定，也不至于和传统牌类完全一样没创新。。。。
